title: Parameter - Tag name
description: The parameter is used as a tag name, i.e. <%q>. The attacker controls the tag name and can inject attributes or close the tag.
php:
Parameter - Tag Name Injection

The q parameter is used directly as the tag name of an HTML element.

Param: ?q=

⬇️ Reflected output (element created with your tag name):

< class="custom-element"> Dynamic Tag Content >
objectives: Supply a custom tag name that allows executing scripts (e.g., script) or inject event handlers.
Inject a payload such as script>alert(1) or img src=x onerror=alert(1)>.
Understand how unvalidated HTML tag names can break DOM structure.
hints: You can type script>alert(1) to close the opening bracket and create a script tag.
